cancerLaterality.description: Determine the laterality of the breast cancer described in the record.
enumDescriptions: Assign 'L': if the breast cancer is documented as involving the left breast.
Assign 'R': if the breast cancer is documented as involving the right breast.
Assign 'B': if breast cancer is documented as bilateral.
Assign null: if breast cancer laterality is unknown, missing, or cannot be determined from the record.

tnmStage.description: Extract the combined TNM stage exactly as explicitly documented in the record, for example cT2N0M0, pT1cN0M0, or ypT0N0. Do not infer TNM stage from tumor size, lymph-node findings, imaging findings, or absence of metastatic disease. Assign null if a combined TNM stage is not explicitly documented.

radiotherapyReceived.description: Determine whether the patient actually received radiotherapy for breast cancer. Treatment that was only planned, recommended, discussed, or considered does not count as received.
enumDescriptions: Assign 'Y': if the record explicitly indicates that radiotherapy was administered to the patient.
Assign 'N': if the record explicitly indicates that the patient did not receive radiotherapy.
Assign null: if radiotherapy status is unknown, missing, or cannot be determined from the record.

chemotherapyReceived.description: Determine whether the patient actually received chemotherapy for breast cancer. Chemotherapy that was only planned, recommended, discussed, or considered does not count as received.
enumDescriptions: Assign 'Y': if the record explicitly indicates that chemotherapy was administered to the patient.
Assign 'N': if the record explicitly indicates that the patient did not receive chemotherapy.
Assign null: if chemotherapy status is unknown, missing, or cannot be determined from the record.

surgeryReceived.description: Determine whether the patient underwent surgery for breast cancer. Surgery that was only planned, recommended, discussed, or considered does not count as received.
enumDescriptions: Assign 'Y': if the record explicitly indicates that breast cancer surgery was performed.
Assign 'N': if the record explicitly indicates that the patient did not undergo breast cancer surgery.
Assign null: if surgery status is unknown, missing, or cannot be determined from the record.
